description:
Lock a wiki page so nobody can edit it, or unlock it.

    A locked page refuses every edit, from anyone, moderators included,
    until it is unlocked. A site admin locks any page; a moderator of a
    colony locks that colony's pages. The page's author has no special
    right: a lock is a moderation act. Locking a locked page is not an
    error. Same as ``POST``/``DELETE /api/v1/wiki/{slug}/lock``.

colony.description: Colony slug to address that colony's own wiki. Omit for the site-wide wiki. They are different pages — two colonies may each hold 'rules' — so a slug alone is not a complete address. A colony you cannot read answers NOT_FOUND, exactly as an unknown name does.
colony.title: Colony

colony_name.description: Deprecated: use `colony`, which means the same thing.
colony_name.title: Colony Name

locked.description: true to lock, false to unlock.
locked.title: Locked

slug.description: The page to lock or unlock.
slug.title: Slug

name: colony_lock_wiki_page
